As a standard action, the crystal dragon deals 5d6 non-elemental damage to all enemies in a 30 ft. cone; a successful Reflex save (DC 25) halves this damage. All enemies within the area of effect who failed the Reflex save must make a series of saves (DC 25) to avoid each of the following effects: Disease (Fort), Silence (Will), Sap (Fort), and Slow (Will), all of which last for 1d8 rounds. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 5th-level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 25).

Sonic Tail (su) A crystal dragon will vibrate its tail sending out sonic waves around itself and those within a 20-ft. radius around himself. Anyone caught in the sonic waves takes 5d4 points of non-elemental damage and are Dazed for 1 round unless they make a Reflex save (DC 25) to take half of the damage and negate the status effect. This ability can also shatter anyone who is already petrified unless they make a Fortitude save (DC 25). Anyone who cannot hear is immune to this effect. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 3rd level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 21).

curation.summary: Juvenile Crystal Dragon is packaged as an FFD20 NPC actor with 57 generated item(s) across 8 populated mechanics categories.
rulesDecisions: Actor data preserves the source statblock in biography and builder flags before any Foundry runtime hydration.
Only true feats, spells, and inventory placeholders are eligible for compendium lookup during import; creature-specific special abilities remain custom generated features.
Racial hit dice are generated from the creature type and source hit dice instead of creating class levels.
Source defensive text is mapped into FFD20 trait fields while unusual FF defenses remain preserved as custom text.
Natural attack items use source attack totals, source damage dice, and manual extra attacks for full-attack routines.
Spell and spell-like ability lines create spell placeholders that should hydrate from installed FFD20/PF spell compendiums.
Skill ranks are reverse-calculated from source totals after ability modifiers, racial modifiers, size modifiers, and class-skill bonuses.
